'''Fall Seeds''' are a type of [[Crafting#Seeds|Crafted]] seed. The crafting recipe is labeled "Wild Seeds (Fa)", but when crafted, the result is "Fall Seeds."  Mature plants yield, at random, a [[Blackberry]], [[Common Mushroom]], [[Hazelnut]], or [[Wild Plum]].  

Fall Seeds are one of the season-specific crafted wild seeds, along with [[Spring Seeds]], [[Summer Seeds]], and [[Winter Seeds]] that produce crops normally found as [[Foraging|forage]].  While Farming Skill normally increases the chance to grow a quality crop, Foraging Skill increases the chance to grow a quality crop from Fall Seeds. Choosing the [[Skills#Foraging|Botanist profession]] will ensure iridium-quality crops grown from Fall Seeds.   

Crows do not attack crops grown from Fall Seeds, so the use of [[Scarecrow]]s is unnecessary.

==Sources==
*[[Crafting]] (each recipe produces 10 Fall Seeds)
*Placing a [[Common Mushroom]] in a [[Seed Maker]] (yield: 1-3 Fall Seeds)
*Completing the {{Bundle|Fall Forage||y}} (reward: 30 Fall Seeds)
*[[Traveling Cart]] (price {{Tprice|45}})
*[[Desert Trader]] on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]] in exchange for 2 [[Winter Seeds]]
*[[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|Treasure rooms]] in the Skull Cavern (5-20 each)

==Profitability==
Fall Seeds are a profitable recipe without the [[Foraging#Foraging Skill|Botanist Profession]]. A craft of Fall seeds yields 10 seeds worth {{Price|450}} total, while a set of regular-quality ingredients to craft it sells for only {{Price|230}} and a set of gold-quality ingredients sells for {{Price|345}}.  With the Botanist Profession, selling the individual crops yields {{Price|460}}.

==Gallery==
[[Crafting#Seeds|Wild Seeds]] from any season may appear similar to dead crops during Stage 2 of growth.

[[File:WildSeedsStage2.png|140px]]

==Bugs==
On [[Ginger Island]], mature Fall Seeds may destroy the tilled soil (and fertilizer), leaving untilled soil in their place after harvest.
